meta.parties: Peries Et Al. v. Perera Et Al

rules.statement: The burden of proof lies with the party propounding a will to remove any suspicion surrounding its execution and to affirmatively establish that the testatrix knew what she was doing when executing it.
rules.supporting_quote: "The rule in Barry v. Butlin extends to all cases in which circumstances exist which excite the suspicion of the Court; and wherever such circumstances exist, and whatever their nature may be it is for those who propound the will to remove such suspicion, and to prove affirmatively that the testatrix knew and approved of the contents of the document."
